extraction: manual curation from public LLIS search

reports.title: SSRMS Joint 3 Anomaly
reports.symptom: Joint 3 exhibited uncommanded motion during payload handoff
reports.root_cause: Bearing preload degradation after 12 years in orbit
reports.recovery: Switched to redundant drive, reduced payload capacity by 20%
reports.lesson: Implement regular joint lubrication schedules beyond original design life

reports.title: Latching End Effector Stuck
reports.symptom: LEE snares failed to close on payload grapple fixture
reports.root_cause: Cold welding of snare cables due to vacuum exposure
reports.recovery: Thermal cycling via sun exposure, multiple retract/extend cycles
reports.lesson: Apply anti-cold-welding coating to LEE snares

reports.title: Camera Glare During EVA
reports.symptom: All external cameras saturated during orbital sunrise
reports.root_cause: Insufficient dynamic range in camera sensors
reports.recovery: Paused robotic operations for 90 seconds until orbital sunset
reports.lesson: Install auto-exposure cameras with wider dynamic range

reports.title: Signal Latency Spike
reports.symptom: Command latency increased from 12min to 45min during solar conjunction
reports.recovery: Switched to pre-loaded command sequences, disabled real-time control
reports.lesson: Plan autonomous operations windows during conjunction periods

reports.title: Tool Power Failure
reports.symptom: Pistol Grip Tool lost power during critical bolt removal
reports.root_cause: Battery thermal protection triggered by prolonged use
reports.recovery: Switched to manual ratchet wrench, added 47 minutes to EVA
reports.lesson: Always carry manual backup tools for critical fasteners

reports.title: Dextre Software State Error
reports.symptom: SPDM entered safe mode during fine manipulation task
reports.root_cause: Race condition in force-moment accommodation firmware
reports.recovery: Ground-commanded full system reboot, reloaded parameters
reports.lesson: Add watchdog timer for force control loops

reports.title: Solar Array Position Drift
reports.symptom: Port solar array position drifted 0.5m from expected during thermal cycling
reports.root_cause: Uneven thermal expansion across array mast
reports.recovery: Updated keep-out zone model, delayed operations until thermal equilibrium
reports.lesson: Include thermal deformation in operational planning models

reports.title: Micrometeoroid Impact on Radiator
reports.symptom: Small leak detected in port radiator panel
reports.root_cause: Micrometeoroid impact during Leonid meteor shower
reports.recovery: Isolated damaged panel, rerouted cooling loops, scheduled EVA repair
reports.lesson: Plan robotic inspections after meteor shower events
